name: tipbox-app
description: Tipbox monorepo - backend, admin-panel, catalog-service, cloudflared tunnel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,catalog "pnpm --filter tipbox-backend dev" "pnpm --filter tipbox-medusa dev"
scripts.tunnel:no-setup: cloudflared tunnel route dns bf6b66c8-5cff-420c-8ea9-a1f67aed24ab api-tipbox.tipbox.co && cloudflared tunnel route dns bf6b66c8-5cff-420c-8ea9-a1f67aed24ab minio-tipbox.tipbox.co && cloudflared tunnel --config cloudflared/config.yml run
scripts.tunnel:pre: cloudflared tunnel route dns bf6b66c8-5cff-420c-8ea9-a1f67aed24ab api-tipbox.tipbox.co && cloudflared tunnel route dns bf6b66c8-5cff-420c-8ea9-a1f67aed24ab minio-tipbox.tipbox.co
